_note: Readout-only summaries of existing game systems; 'both' means the entry is generic, not a declaration of historical availability. Variable sizes are not flattened to fictitious fixed values. See DesignItems, DesignWeight and corresponding rules.

entries.name: Targeting Computer
entries.about: Improves eligible direct-fire attacks by 1; permits certain aimed shots at moving targets. Weight and slots depend on linked weapon tonnage and subsystem technology.

entries.name: Artemis IV FCS
entries.about: Adds 2 to eligible missile cluster rolls. 1 t per launcher; see WeaponModes.

entries.name: Artemis V FCS
entries.about: Adds 3 to eligible missile cluster rolls; uses matching guided ammunition. 1.5 t, 2 slots.

entries.name: Apollo FCS
entries.about: Removes the MRM's negative cluster modifier; also supports saturation mode. 1 t, 1 slot.

entries.name: PPC Capacitor
entries.about: Charge before firing; adds 5 damage and 5 heat to a charged shot. Holding charge generates heat. 1 t, 1 slot.

entries.name: C3 Master
entries.about: Coordinates a C3 network and shares range brackets. 5 t, 5 slots.

entries.name: C3 Slave
entries.about: Connects to a C3 master to share range brackets. 1 t, 1 slot.

entries.name: Boosted C3 Master
entries.about: Boosted C3 network master; only Angel ECM degrades a boosted member's link. 6 t, 6 slots.

entries.name: Boosted C3 Slave
entries.about: Boosted C3 network member. 3 t, 2 slots.

entries.name: Improved C3 (C3i)
entries.about: Masterless network of up to six units; shares range brackets. 2.5 t, 2 slots.

entries.name: CASE
entries.about: Limits ammunition explosion damage transfer. Explicit installed CASE weighs 0.5 t in the game's construction calculation.

entries.name: CASE II
entries.about: Enhanced explosion protection; weight depends on subsystem technology (0.5 t Clan, 1 t Inner Sphere in the game's calculation).

entries.name: Integral Clan CASE
entries.about: Clan BattleMechs have built-in CASE without additional equipment weight.

entries.name: MASC
entries.about: Can double walking MP for running; consecutive use raises failure risk. Tons and slots depend on chassis tonnage and tech.

entries.name: Supercharger
entries.about: Can increase running speed; repeated use increases failure risk and may damage the engine. 1 slot; weight depends on engine.

entries.name: Triple-Strength Myomer (TSM)
entries.about: At heat 9 or above, adds 2 walking MP and doubles eligible physical attack damage. 6 slots, no added weight.

entries.name: Standard Jump Jet
entries.about: Adds jumping movement; 1 slot per jet. Weight depends on chassis tonnage.

entries.name: Improved Jump Jet
entries.about: Reduces jump heat relative to standard jets. 2 slots per jet; twice standard jet weight.

entries.name: Single Heat Sink
entries.about: Dissipates 1 heat per working sink. First ten are included in the engine; installation slots depend on engine capacity.

entries.name: Double Heat Sink
entries.about: Dissipates 2 heat per working sink. External sinks use 3 slots Inner Sphere or 2 Clan.

entries.name: Hatchet
entries.about: Physical weapon. Weight and critical slots scale with BattleMech tonnage.

entries.name: Sword
entries.about: Physical weapon. Weight and critical slots scale with BattleMech tonnage.

entries.name: Standard Armor
entries.about: Baseline armor; the construction checker uses 16 points per ton.

entries.name: Ferro-Fibrous Armor
entries.about: More armor points per ton than standard: 12% Inner Sphere, 20% Clan in the game's construction checker.

entries.name: Light Ferro-Fibrous Armor
entries.about: 6% more armor points per ton in the construction checker.

entries.name: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor
entries.about: 24% more armor points per ton in the construction checker.

entries.name: Standard Internal Structure
entries.about: Baseline internal structure; construction weight depends on chassis tonnage.

entries.name: Standard Fusion Engine
entries.about: Baseline engine; weight depends on engine rating.

entries.name: XL Fusion Engine
entries.about: Lightweight engine extending into the side torsos. Side-torso engine critical slots differ by subsystem technology.

entries.name: Light Fusion Engine
entries.about: Uses two engine slots in each side torso.

entries.name: Compact Fusion Engine
entries.about: Fits in three center-torso slots; weight depends on engine rating.

entries.name: Standard Cockpit
entries.about: Standard BattleMech cockpit. 3 t.

entries.name: Small Cockpit
entries.about: 2 t, frees two head slots; +1 to piloting rolls.
